18.html:
A cinematic wedding film turns the best moments of your day into a short movie — dramatic angles, carefully chosen music, and creative cinematography woven around the story you are actually living. It is the most stylized film we make, and the one couples share first.

Digital Video Productions has been filming weddings on Florida’s Gulf Coast since 1995. We shoot in an unobtrusive, documentary style — small handheld cameras, no barked instructions — so the emotion in your film is real rather than staged. Every package is filmed on broadcast-quality HD equipment with a remote microphone for clear audio, professionally edited, and delivered online for easy sharing and download.

The films on this page were made for real couples in and around Sarasota. A Cinematic Short can be added to any videography package for $500, or ask us about building a package around one. We serve Venice, Sarasota, North Port, Bradenton, Port Charlotte, Fort Myers, Punta Gorda, Clearwater, St. Petersburg and Tampa, and we travel for destination weddings.

Browse the samples below, then compare our wedding video packages or check your date — popular weekends book early.

21.html:
A highlight recap condenses your whole wedding day into a short film set to music — getting ready, the first look, the vows, the toasts and the dance floor, edited down to the moments you will want to relive again and again. It is the film couples send to family, post for friends, and come back to on every anniversary.

We film in a documentary style and stay unobtrusive, so your recap is full of genuine reactions rather than posed scenes. Like everything we deliver, it is shot on broadcast-quality HD equipment with remote microphones for clear audio — you hear your vows and toasts, not the wind — professionally edited, and delivered digitally for sharing and download.

A Highlight Recap can be added to any package for $350, and it pairs naturally with full ceremony coverage: the recap for sharing, the full edit for keeping. Digital Video Productions has filmed couples across Venice, Sarasota, Bradenton, St. Petersburg and Tampa since 1995, and travels for destination weddings.

Watch the samples below, then see our packages or check your wedding date.

20.html:
A full documentary edit preserves your wedding day as it actually happened — the complete ceremony, the speeches and toasts, the first dance and the moments in between, in order and in full. Years from now, this is the film that lets you sit down and watch your whole day again, not just the highlights.

Documentary coverage is the heart of what Digital Video Productions has done since 1995. Our approach is deliberately unobtrusive: with small handheld cameras and lights we look more like invited guests than a production crew, so what we capture is your day, not a performance of it. Remote microphones record your vows and speeches cleanly, and everything is shot on broadcast-quality HD equipment and professionally edited.

Options like a second ceremony camera ($200) or additional coverage hours extend how much of the day we preserve, and a Highlight Recap makes a shareable companion to the full film. We serve Venice, Sarasota, North Port, Bradenton, Fort Myers, Clearwater, St. Petersburg and Tampa, and travel for destination weddings.

Watch full documentary samples below, then compare packages or get in touch about your date.

22.html:
Your ceremony happens once, with no second take — the walk down the aisle, the vows, the rings, the first kiss. Ceremony videography is about capturing all of it cleanly and completely while staying invisible enough that you forget the cameras are there.

We place remote microphones so your vows and readings are recorded clearly, even outdoors on a breezy Gulf Coast beach, and we film on broadcast-quality HD equipment in an unobtrusive documentary style. For fuller coverage, an extra ceremony camera can be added to any package for $200 — a second angle means we never miss a reaction, yours or your guests’.

Digital Video Productions has filmed ceremonies across Venice, Sarasota, North Port, Bradenton, Port Charlotte, Fort Myers, Clearwater, St. Petersburg and Tampa since 1995, indoors and on the beach, and we travel for destination weddings. Every edit is finished professionally and delivered online for easy sharing and download.

Watch ceremony samples below, then see what every package includes or check availability for your date.

25.html:
An engagement video tells the story of the two of you before the wedding day — how you met, the proposal, the things you love about each other — filmed somewhere that matters to you. Couples use them for save-the-dates, wedding websites, and to play at the reception while guests find their seats.

Filming an engagement session together is also the best possible rehearsal for the wedding itself: you get comfortable being on camera with us, and we learn how the two of you naturally are together — which makes the wedding film better too.

Like all of our work, engagement videos are shot on broadcast-quality HD equipment in a relaxed documentary style and professionally edited, with digital delivery for sharing and download. Digital Video Productions has filmed couples across Venice, Sarasota, Bradenton, St. Petersburg and Tampa since 1995 — on beaches, in parks, and anywhere your story started.

Watch a sample below, then see our packages or tell us your story.

24.html:
A memorial video honors a life by gathering its moments in one place — photographs, home movies and music, edited with care into a tribute that can be shown at a service and kept by the family afterward.

We approach memorial work with the same discretion we bring to weddings: gently, unobtrusively and on your timeline. Bring us photographs from any era and video in nearly any format — transferring older media is one of our services — and we will professionally edit them into a film the whole family can share. Delivery is digital for easy sharing and download, and a DVD with a personalized case ($49) or Blu-Ray disc ($99) is available for relatives who prefer a physical keepsake.

Digital Video Productions has served families in Venice, Sarasota, North Port, Bradenton, Port Charlotte, Fort Myers, Clearwater, St. Petersburg and Tampa since 1995. If a service is coming up quickly, call us and we will talk through the timeline together.

Call or email us to talk about what you have in mind.

23.html:
A photo montage sets your photographs to music — edited with pacing, motion and care, so a folder of pictures becomes something people actually sit down and watch. Families use them for milestone birthdays and anniversaries, graduations, retirements, rehearsal dinners and memorial services.

Bring us prints, slides or digital photos from any era; we can also transfer older home video formats and weave clips in alongside the stills. Every montage is professionally edited and delivered digitally for easy sharing and download, with a DVD in a personalized case ($49) or Blu-Ray ($99) available as a keepsake.

A montage also makes a lovely addition to a wedding: played at the rehearsal dinner or reception, it introduces the two of you to guests through the years of photos that led to the day. Digital Video Productions has been editing family memories from its home in Venice, FL since 1995, serving Sarasota, Bradenton, and families from Port Charlotte to Tampa.

Watch a sample below, then get in touch to tell us about the occasion.

26.html:
Digital Video Productions produces music videos for bands, solo artists and performers across Florida’s Gulf Coast — from single-location performance pieces to story-driven shoots across several settings.

We bring the same tools we use on our cinematic wedding films: broadcast-quality HD cameras, clean location audio with remote microphones, creative cinematography and professional editing. Aerial drone coverage can be added when your video deserves an opening shot bigger than a rooftop. And because we film real events every weekend in a documentary style, we work quickly and stay out of the performance — useful when the light is going and the take matters.

Based in Venice, FL, we work with artists throughout Sarasota, Bradenton, Port Charlotte, Fort Myers, St. Petersburg and Tampa. Finished videos are delivered digitally, ready for YouTube and social sharing.

Watch samples below, then tell us about your track — we will talk through locations, treatment and budget together.

19.html:
Digital Video Productions makes commercial video for businesses on Florida’s Gulf Coast — promotional videos, real estate walkthroughs and aerials, training videos and broadcast commercials. If your business needs to be seen, we can film it.

You work with the same crew that films our award-winning weddings: broadcast-quality HD cameras, remote microphones for clean interview audio, aerial drone coverage where a property or venue deserves the wide view, and professional editing through to digital delivery — files ready for your website, social channels and advertising.

Being a small local team keeps it simple: you talk directly to the people holding the cameras. We are based in Venice, FL, work with businesses across Sarasota, Bradenton, Port Charlotte, Fort Myers, St. Petersburg and Tampa, and have been in production since 1995.

17.html:
Digital Video Productions has been recognized repeatedly for its wedding videography — including Best Sarasota Videography — with awards earned in both Florida and Connecticut across more than 25 years in production.

We are prouder still of what the awards stand for: films made unobtrusively, edited with care, and delivered to couples who tell their friends. Read our couples’ reviews through the links on this page — reviews from real weddings say more than any trophy shelf.
